entries.name: EE_RAM_BASE
entries.comment: EE Main RAM base (physical)

entries.name: EE_KERNEL_BASE
entries.comment: EE kernel / OS loaded here by BIOS

entries.name: MUL64
entries.comment: 64x64-bit multiply: v0 = a0 * a1 (lower 64 bits). Used by LCGPRNGStep as the LCG multiply step.

entries.name: FloatMul
entries.comment: Software FP: double-precision multiply (a0 * a1). Called by DeriveKeySchedule to normalize PRNG output to [0,1) then scale to [0,256).

entries.name: IntToFloat
entries.comment: Software FP: convert signed 32-bit int (a0) to double-precision float. Used by DeriveKeySchedule to convert raw PRNG output to float.

entries.name: FloatToUInt
entries.comment: Software FP: convert double-precision float (a0) to unsigned int (floor). Final step in PRNG-to-byte conversion: floor(prng/2^31*256) = prng>>23.

entries.name: PatchLoaderEntry
entries.comment: Patch loader entry point. Processes ZDB files (APACHE00.ZDB etc) during PS2 boot/network auth sequence.

entries.name: gMWo3FTScoreOutput
entries.comment: Decrypted MWo3 FTScore output buffer. Starts with magic 4D 57 6F 33 (MWo3). Filled by jalr s5 (the actual FTScore payload decryptor) before BlockCipherOrchestrator is called.

entries.name: AES_CBC_Wrapper
entries.comment: AES-CBC decrypt wrapper: a0=cipher_ctx, a1=ciphertext_in, a2=plaintext_out, a3=len_bytes. Cipher ctx +0x58 = key schedule ptr, +0x70 = IV buffer ptr.

entries.name: AES_BlockPrimitive
entries.comment: Inner AES block primitive: a0=IV_ptr, a1=key_schedule_ptr, a2=ciphertext_16bytes. Processes a single 16-byte AES block.

entries.name: ZDBXform_XOR1_ROL19
entries.comment: Vtable idx 5. ZDB block xform: (w ^ 0x09F8ED17) then ROL32_19 per word.

entries.name: ZDBXform_XOR2_ROL16
entries.comment: Vtable idx 6. ZDB block xform: (w ^ 0xA95128C3) then ROL32_16 per word.

entries.name: ZDBXform_Compound7
entries.comment: Vtable idx 7. ZDB block xform (compound): XOR1 -> ROL24 -> ROL19 -> bperm7. Net: (w^0x09F8ED17) ROL11, then byte perm [b3,b2,b1,b0]->[b1,b3,b0,b2].

entries.name: ZDBXform_XOR1
entries.comment: Vtable idx 0. ZDB block xform: each word ^= 0x09F8ED17. No rotation.

entries.name: ZDBXform_XOR2
entries.comment: Vtable idx 1. ZDB block xform: each word ^= 0xA95128C3. No rotation.

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL32_19
entries.comment: Vtable idx 2. ZDB block xform: ROL32_19 per word. Masks 0xFFF80000 and 0x0007FFFF.

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL32_24
entries.comment: Vtable idx 3. ZDB block xform: ROL32_24 (= ROR8) per word. (w<<24)|(w>>8).

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL32_16
entries.comment: Vtable idx 4. ZDB block xform: ROL32_16 per word (swap upper/lower 16-bit halves). (w<<16)|(w>>16).

entries.name: gZDBFTScoreConfig
entries.comment: ZDB section config struct for FTScore (Call 1 to ZDBSectionDecrypt). Fields: [+0]=section_type, [+4]=IOP_data_end_ptr, [+8]=?, [+C]=IOP_data_start_ptr. IOP ptrs are uncached bus addresses into APACHE00.ZDB mapped in IOP RAM. Used at 0x5412A0 call site near 0x534960.

entries.name: FTScoreChunkDecryptCall
entries.comment: jalr s5 instruction in FTScore chunk decrypt loop. s5=FTScoreChunkDecryptor(0x541658). a0=context(IV+key), a1=chunk_size(0x80), a2=output_buf, a3=ciphertext. Returns; chain state in context[0..15] updated.

entries.name: afterOrchestratorReturn
entries.comment: Return address from BlockCipherOrchestrator to its caller (0x005349D0 area). After this point, the 200-PRNG key bytes from DeriveKeySchedule have been generated.

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL13_XOR1
entries.comment: Vtable idx D. ZDB block xform: ROL32_13 then XOR 0x09F8ED17 per word. Confirmed from disasm: shift mask s6=0xE000 (ROL13), s2=0x09F8ED17.

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL8_XOR2_Perm
entries.comment: Vtable idx E. ZDB block xform: ROL32_8 -> XOR 0xA95128C3 -> bpermc per word. bpermc: [b3,b2,b1,b0]->[b2,b0,b3,b1]=(b2<<24)|(b0<<16)|(b3<<8)|b1.

entries.name: ZDBXform_Perm_ROL13_ROL8_XOR1
entries.comment: Vtable idx F. ZDB block xform: bpermc -> ROL32_13 -> ROL32_8 -> XOR 0x09F8ED17 per word. bpermc: [b3,b2,b1,b0]->[b2,b0,b3,b1].

entries.name: ZDBXform_XOR1_v8
entries.comment: Vtable idx 8. ZDB block xform: XOR each word with 0x09F8ED17. Alternate implementation of vtable[0]/ZDBXform_XOR1 — identical transform, different code copy.

entries.name: ZDBXform_XOR2_v9
entries.comment: Vtable idx 9. ZDB block xform: XOR each word with 0xA95128C3. Alternate implementation of vtable[1]/ZDBXform_XOR2 — identical transform, different code copy.

entries.name: StorePRNGSeed
entries.comment: Stores 24-bit ZDB ID (a0) to Memory64[0x560A10] as 64-bit LCG state seed

entries.name: LCGPRNGStep
entries.comment: LCG PRNG: state = state * 0x5851F42D4C957F2D + 1 (mod 2^64), returns (state>>32)&0x7FFFFFFF

entries.name: ReadSeedFromDNAS
entries.comment: Reads 6 bytes from DNAS blob via 0x0018F6E0, reconstructs 24-bit ZDB seed from [sp+1][sp+2][sp+3][sp+5], calls StorePRNGSeed. Returns 0.

entries.name: KeyEntryVerify
entries.comment: Verifies key table entry signature/MAC (RSA or HMAC). a0=entry_data a1=metadata a2=output_sp. Returns 0 on success.

entries.name: KeyEntryDecrypt
entries.comment: AES-decrypts a key table entry using the per-entry key. a0=encrypted_entry a1=decrypt_key a2=sp_output. Produces plaintext key bytes at sp.

entries.name: DecryptKeyEntry
entries.comment: Decrypts a key table entry: calls KeyEntryVerify (0x53E038) + KeyEntryDecrypt (0x53E448). a0=decrypt_key ptr, a1=encrypted_entry, a2=output_buf, a3=metadata ptr.

entries.name: DeriveKeySchedule
entries.comment: Derives key schedule: a0=key_index, a1=?, a2=output_buf. Decrypts key entry[a0] via DecryptKeyEntry, then runs 200-iteration LCG PRNG loop, stores 1 byte per iteration to stack. Stores count from key entry to a2[0].

entries.name: BlockCipherOrchestrator
entries.comment: Block cipher orchestrator: a0=ctx, a1=chunk_count, a2=output, a3=input. Calls ReadSeedFromDNAS, computes index=(a1-0x46), calls DeriveKeySchedule. Does NOT directly do AES - just inits key material.

entries.name: AES_CBC_Core
entries.comment: Core AES-CBC block decryption engine. t1=key_size(16), a0=output, a1=IV/chain_state, a2=ciphertext, a3=AES key, t0=block count. Processes t0 16-byte blocks.

entries.name: AES_Thunk_CBC
entries.comment: AES dispatch thunk: sets t1=0x10 (key size=16 bytes) and jumps to 0x0053FC60. Called from FTScoreChunkDecryptor for separate-buffer case. a0=output a1=context a2=ciphertext a3=context+0x10 (AES key).

entries.name: ZDBDispatchWordEncoder
entries.comment: Dispatch word encoder. Input a0 = raw ZDB opcode word. Extracts 3-bit nibbles from bits[27:0] of a0, packs them into return value v0[27:0]. Top nibble v0[31:28] = operation count (how many vtable dispatches to perform per block). Called at start of ZDBBlockProcessor (0x540938).

entries.name: gZDBStreamTable
entries.comment: ZDB stream table. Array of stream entry descriptors used by ZDBStreamReader (0x541378) to locate/map ZDB section data from IOP RAM. Read by ZDBSectionDecrypt (0x5412A0) before block processing.

entries.name: ZDBSectionDecrypt
entries.comment: Decrypts one ZDB section. Called 5+ times per ZDB load. a0=output_struct, a1=IOP_src_end_ptr (BAFA4BC8), a2=IOP_src_start_ptr (BAFA4B78), a3=flags. Internally calls 0x541378 (stream reader) and 0x540938 (vtable-dispatched block processor). Each call handles one named ZDB section (ftscore, zsealetc, etc).

entries.name: ZDBStreamReader
entries.comment: ZDB stream reader / DMA setup called by ZDBSectionDecrypt (0x5412A0). First jal inside ZDBSectionDecrypt (at 0x5412A8). Reads IOP-side ZDB data (uncached bus ptrs in a1/a2) into EE RAM staging area. Returns ptr to loaded data. Called before ZDBBlockProcessor (0x540938).

entries.name: ZDBPostBlockMerge
entries.comment: Post-vtable-loop processing step inside ZDBSectionDecrypt (0x5412A0). Called after all vtable transforms complete on a block. Purpose: merge/finalize block before AES decrypt. Args: a0=output_buf, a2=byte_count.

entries.name: FTScoreChunkDecryptor
entries.comment: FTScore chunk decryptor: a0=context/state, a1=0x80 (chunk size?), a2=output_buf, a3=ciphertext_ptr. The actual payload decryptor called by jalr s5 from 0x534A5C.

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL32_13
entries.comment: Vtable idx A (0xA). ZDB block transform: ROL32 by 13 bits. Applied per 32-bit word in block. Args: a0=ptr_start, a1=ptr_end, a2=chunk_ctx, a3=key, t0=block_ctx. Calls 0x540890 (block init). Called via jalr v0 at 0x5409C8 inside ZDBBlockProcessor dispatch loop.

entries.name: ZDBXform_ROL32_8
entries.comment: Vtable idx B (0xB). ZDB block transform: ROL32 by 8 bits (= byte rotation). Applied per 32-bit word in block. Args same as ZDBXform_ROL32_13. Called via jalr v0 at 0x5409C8 inside ZDBBlockProcessor.

entries.name: ZDBXform_BytePerm
entries.comment: Vtable idx C (0xC). ZDB block transform: 32-bit byte permutation [b3,b2,b1,b0]->[b2,b0,b3,b1]. = rotate(8) with swap? Applied per 32-bit word. Args same as ZDBXform_ROL32_13. Called via jalr v0 at 0x5409C8 inside ZDBBlockProcessor.

entries.name: gPRNGState
entries.comment: LCG PRNG state (64-bit, LE). Written by StorePRNGSeed with initial 24-bit ZDB ID. Advanced by LCGPRNGStep on each call (state = state * 0x5851F42D4C957F2D + 1 mod 2^64).

entries.name: gKeyTable
entries.comment: Key table base. 200-byte entries, stride 200. Entry[i] at 0x560A20 + i*200. DeriveKeySchedule indexes by (chunk_count - 0x46). Entry[7]=FTScore at 0x560F98.

entries.name: gFTScoreKeyEntry
entries.comment: FTScore key table entry (index 7). 200 bytes. [+0]: encrypted entry data. [+0x10]: Sony Key 2 for this entry (used by DecryptKeyEntry as a0). Entry decrypts to provide count/format for DeriveKeySchedule.

entries.name: gSonyKey2_FTScore
entries.comment: Sony Key 2 for FTScore entry decryption: 67 8A 62 A2 BB E9 9D 06 F5 15 D6 CC DE E9 A1 9D. Used as a0 arg to DecryptKeyEntry.

entries.name: gSonyKey1
entries.comment: Sony Master Key 1 schedule first 16 bytes: 53 87 A6 18 EA 98 13 16 F9 15 1E 81 59 FB 86 B5. Round key 0 = AES key for DNAS blob decryption.

entries.name: gZDBVtable
entries.comment: 16-entry function pointer table for ZDB outer block transforms. Entry[i] = transform fn pointer. Indexed 0x0-0xF by ZDBBlockProcessor (0x540938) dispatch loop. Addresses: [0]=XOR1, [1]=XOR2, [2]=ROL19, [3]=ROL24, [4]=ROL16, [5]=XOR1+ROL19, [6]=XOR2+ROL16, [7]=Compound7, [8]=XOR1_v8, [9]=XOR2_v9, [A]=ROL13, [B]=ROL8, [C]=BytePerm, [D]=ROL13+XOR1, [E]=ROL8+XOR2+Perm, [F]=Perm+ROL13+ROL8+XOR1.

entries.name: gMediusAuthTokenTable
entries.comment: Medius auth token table. 20 captured tokens, each a null-terminated string. Used during Medius network authentication sequence.

entries.name: gFTScoreIV
entries.comment: FTScore IV buffer (all zeros, confirmed). Used as IV for FTScore payload AES-CBC decrypt via cipher_ctx+0x70.

entries.name: gDNASIV
entries.comment: DNAS IV buffer (all zeros). Used as IV for DNAS blob AES-CBC decrypt via cipher_ctx+0x70.

entries.name: gCipherCtx
entries.comment: AES cipher context struct. +0x58 = ptr to key schedule. +0x70 = ptr to IV buffer. Used by AES_CBC_Wrapper. Key schedule filled before each decrypt, zeroed after.

entries.name: gDNASKeySchedule
entries.comment: DNAS AES key schedule buffer (176 bytes for AES-128). Filled when processing DNAS blob with Sony Key 1, zeroed after use.

entries.name: gFTScoreKeySchedule
entries.comment: FTScore AES key schedule buffer. Expected to hold decrypted key schedule for payload AES decrypt. Found all-zeros in session - key may be held on IOP side or cleared quickly after use.

entries.name: gZDBBase
entries.comment: ZDB file base loaded into EE RAM. Header: FC 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 11 22 89 41 01 00 00 00 / 00 00 00 00 72 30 30 30 31 (r0001). DNAS blob starts at EE+0x1E0 = 0x01E7EC30. Encrypted FTScore payload at EE+0x3E0 = 0x01E7EE30.

entries.name: gAESCtx_IV
entries.comment: AES-CBC context: first 16 bytes = IV / chain state. Initialized to real IV before first chunk, updated to last CT block after each AES call (CBC chaining). Captured: 84 C2 7C 37 D9 07 C2 C1 8E 32 8F 18 7F 44 CF 6A

entries.name: gAESCtx_Key
entries.comment: AES-CBC context: bytes 16-31 = AES-128 key (constant across all chunks of one section). Captured: 0D EE 71 86 A4 C4 54 63 00 03 23 A6 86 34 C9 0B. Key source: IOP-side DNAS decryption, NOT raw ZDB bytes.

entries.name: gAESCiphertextBuf
entries.comment: AES ciphertext input buffer. 128 bytes per chunk. SOURCE UNKNOWN - bytes do NOT appear in ZDB file or IOP RAM verbatim. Possibly transformed by ZDBSectionDecrypt (0x5412A0) stream reader before passing to AES. First block captured: F2 8B 0F 90 A5 DA 9C A0 05 51 49 F6 E4 85 18 16

entries.name: gDNASBlob
entries.comment: DNAS blob in EE RAM. 0x300 bytes (offset 0x1E0 from gZDBBase). Starts: 83 F4 06 0A 3D E2 BA E4... Contains DNAS authentication data read by ReadSeedFromDNAS (0x53D438) to extract FTScore seed 0x02291104.

entries.name: gMediusSessionKey
entries.comment: AES-128 session key (16 bytes). Medius SDK session key, provisioned by DNAS server during auth. Changes every boot/reconnect. Boot-time value: 875f14c4a8c3a28c18616d00903e6bb1. Followed at +0x10 by 16-byte IV.

entries.name: gAESDecryptOutput
entries.comment: AES-128 CBC decryption output buffer. 128 bytes per chunk. Written by AES_CBC_Core (0x53FC60), called from FTScoreChunkDecryptor (0x541658) ~880 times. After all chunks decrypted, complete MWo3 appears at gMWo3FTScoreOutput (0x1E7000). First chunk output: E4 08 94 FD AF 50 2A 36...

entries.name: EE_RAM_END
entries.comment: EE Main RAM top (32 MB, physical)
